_whyThisFileExists: The converter bundles with esbuild, whose resolver tries `.tsx` BEFORE `.ts` and matches
directory entries case-INSENSITIVELY. This package pairs a component with its logic under one
name — `Spark.tsx` draws what `spark.ts` computes, `WorkflowContract.tsx` renders what
`WorkflowContract.tsx`, and the build dies on 33 'No matching export' errors naming a file the
importer never asked for. Vite is unaffected: its resolveExtensions put `.ts` first.
The converter exposes no resolveExtensions knob and lib/bundle.mjs must not be forked, so the
disambiguation goes where a config hook already exists: it reads compilerOptions.paths from
cfg.tsconfig and resolves those specifiers itself, extension-first. Each rule below is an
EXACT specifier (the plugin only fires on equality), so nothing else is redirected.
This file does NOT extend the real tsconfig — the plugin JSON.parses it and reads only
compilerOptions.paths and baseUrl, following no extends chain — so the app's three aliases are
repeated here verbatim. Keep them in step with tsconfig.json.
